$comment: What the creative hotbar places (docs/ITEMS.md). Each item names the block it places (shared/blocks) and its height in ½ m cells (`rows`, up to 2). Owner, 2026-10-28: the hotbar's blocks are ½ m (the 1 m items are gone; `rows` stays for a taller piece later). `drag`: what holding Place does with it (docs/ITEMS.md §5): `modes` (the default) builds on in the build mode, for a plain block only; `vertical` a line straight up or down only, each piece where it is held (ladders on their wall); `none` one click at a time (a block with other cells or something to stand on). `state`: property values of the state it places (a slope's shape); `facing`: `toward` turns its `facing` property to point back at the player, `away` along the look (a stored ramp's facing is its downhill side: `toward` puts uphill ahead, owner 2026-10-30); `upper`: a 2-row piece's upper cell, its state with these values over the lower's (the steep slope's top half), placed with it. `tool` (instead of `block`): a tool of shared/tools/tools.json by item name, which places nothing (the stone axe: held, it chops; ADR 0067). The order is the hotbar's. Prototype content. Run `node shared/items/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/items.gen.rs is stale.

hotbar.$comment: Stepping the hotbar's selection without number keys (docs/ITEMS.md §6; owner, 2026-11-07: on a sensitive touchpad with no wheel it was almost impossible to pick a piece). `prevKey` / `nextKey` (KeyboardEvent.code) step one slot left / right, wrapping, held keys repeating. The wheel and a touchpad's two-finger swipes (vertical, and horizontal as `deltaX`) step it too, through an accumulator: the first wheel event after `wheelGapMs` of quiet steps one slot at once (a mouse notch), and then every `wheelNotchPx` of travel in the same gesture steps one more, so a sensitive pad's stream of small deltas and its momentum don't skip several slots. A reversed direction starts over.

buildModes.$comment: What holding Place does after the first block (docs/ITEMS.md §5; owner, 2026-10-28): keep building as the aim moves, in the mode chosen. `key` (KeyboardEvent.code) cycles the modes, as does the controller's buildMode button (shared/input/gamepad.json) and the touch Build button; the first is the default. Kinds (the engine's vocabulary, crates/dwell-game/src/build_drag.rs): `line` builds on in a straight line out of the face first clicked, as far as the aim reaches along it; `level` paints the cells the aim sweeps over at the first block's level (floors and ceilings). `clearance` (m): how far the player's own body must be clear of a cell before a block goes in it (above it, jumping, when towering): the server sees the body a little later, and refuses a block placed into it. `holdMs`: how long Place is held before it builds on, so a click places one block (owner, 2026-10-28); a touch hold waits its own 350 ms instead.
